author: PawsUnpaws_
body:
So after about a year of playing nebula maps, I figured I'd make my own just for the hell of it. It turned out better than expected, so I thought I'd send it off to the guys down at Avicus and see if they'd add it to the network.

Description:
The map is a destroy/break the monument. There are 2 monuments for each team: left and right. I've intended for the teams to be Red v. Blue, roughly 20-25 player limit, and for each player to spawn with team-colour dyed leather armor, an infinity bow, an iron sword, one arrow (duh), 8 steaks, and an gold apple. The iron beneath spawn, is meant to limited. Like any good nebula map, there is a small amount of diamond hidden near spawn; I've put mine in the middle-rear iron pile. The team islands are identical, i just didn't feel like taking screenshots of both sides. I came up with the name in 30 seconds, so i might change it.
 
Here's the map link, take a look, feel free to edit it as you please!
Download from Mediafire: http://www.mediafire.com/download/0s1y2aoo6k3zsej/Cypher+V+1.0+by+PawsUnpaws_.rar

Screenshots below or view album at http://imgur.com/a/Iohd6 
I have included an overview of the map.
(I know the screenshots are in the wrong order, sorry!)
